children: CANBERA (dpa-AFX) - Aristocrat Leisure Ltd. (ALL.AX) announced earnings for its full year that Increased, from the same period last year
The company's earnings came in at A$1.450 billion, or A$2.383 per share.  This compares with A$1.421 billion, or A$2.265 per share, last year.
The company's revenue for the period fell 3.3% to A$6.092 billion from A$6.297 billion last year.
Aristocrat Leisure Ltd. earnings at a glance (GAAP) :
-Earnings: A$1.450 Bln. vs. A$1.421 Bln. last year.
-Revenue: A$6.092 Bln vs. A$6.297 Bln last year.
